cards.title: Notifications after saving
cards.coverage: Implemented native Swift · review branch
cards.note: The same native animated examples and ProductUpsellScreen are used. “ASTIR” and “now” repeat on each card. Examples are labeled as examples in accessibility; the visible source does not include a separate Examples label. Neutral Continue applies to not-determined or currently allowed OS states; denied uses Open Settings. Not now exists only after the initial permission state. Working state says Turning on notifications…. Shown only while notifications are not enabled: iOS authorized/provisional/ephemeral AND app pushEnabled must both be true to suppress the campaign. Frequency cap is one lifetime impression per trigger, three for the campaign. No copy update resolving N28/N29 differentiation has been chosen. Ryan and Mina are fictional example names; these are not actual delivered notifications.
